BETWEEN:-
 BHIKAM YADAV S/O SHRI SARJU YADAV, AGED
ABOUT  45 YEARS
, OCCUPATION:

LABOUR CHHEVLAKHERA  BHELDA POLICE STATION BAMNOURA DISTRICT  CHHATARPUR (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI SURDEEP KHAMPARIYA - ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION BAMNOURA DISTRICT CHHATARPUR  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI SANTOSH YADAV - GOVT. ADVOCATE)
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:

ORDER This is first application filed by applicant/accused under Section 439 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.68/2023, registered at Police Station Bamnoura District-Chhatarpur (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 376 of IPC.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
Prosecutrix is major, aged about 35 years.
There is civil dispute between applicant and husband of prosecutrix.
In these circumstances, applicant has falsely been implicated in the case and he may be enlarged on bail.

3 . Learned Govt. Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of bail and read over the statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C.

sentences.text: 4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

5. In her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., prosecutrix has stated that applicant has forcefully committed rape on her at 06.30 pm, thereafter, she returned to her house and on way, she met her husband, then both of them went to police station for lodging of report and report was lodged at 1 am.
There are direct allegations against the applicant.
There is no reason to disbelieve prosecutrix at this stage.
No document is filed by applicant with regard to fact that there was some civil dispute between the applicant and prosecutrix.
6. Considering the aforesaid, b ail application filed by the applicant is dismissed.
7. Applicant is at liberty to file repeat bail application after examination of prosecutrix in Court.
